PAYDAR / BETA 0.3.0

Install and test.

New in 0.3

Optional Google sign-in, account details, sign-out and cloud-account deletion. Open Account to begin. An internet connection and Google Play services are needed for sign-in. Local payment records remain on this installation and are not synced or separated by account.

The website adds stronger scroll-driven 3D depth and more consistent typography, spacing and touch targets. Reduced-motion settings are respected.

What is included

  • QR decoding from the camera and a selected image.
  • UPI-ID format checks, imported local risk records, explicit unknown results, and recent check history.
  • Three-question MuleGuard guidance.
  • Recovery report drafting, local save, and user-initiated sharing.
  • Subscription entry, paste-based message parsing, optional SMS import, local reminders, editing, pause, and deletion.
  • Unified transaction history: selected-app notification capture, UPI SMS import, pasted/shared receipts, manual records, search, filters, correction, deletion and CSV import/export. Totals reflect imported successful receipts, not bank balances.

Transaction history setup

Open Payments, select your payment apps and optionally enable notification capture in Android settings. Existing private in-app histories cannot be retrieved automatically. Import available UPI SMS or use the PayDar CSV format for older records. Unsupported or redacted notification text can leave gaps.

What is not connected

  • No automated authoritative fraud feed. The official I4C suspect search opens in your browser and requires its own CAPTCHA and terms.
  • No physical QR sticker-tamper model.
  • No on-device language model or NPU benchmark.
  • No automatic dispute filing, payment reversal, or refund guarantee.

Install

Download the debug APK on an Android 8.0 or newer device you control. Android may ask you to allow installation from the browser or file manager. Only install a build whose checksum and source you trust.

This is a testing build, not a production fraud-protection service. Do not enter your UPI PIN, OTP, password, or full card details into PayDar.

Download SHA-256 checksum

Validation

The Android build passed 45 automated checks covering input parsing, risk rules, transaction deduplication, CSV parsing and SQLite persistence/migration. The APK uses the same debug certificate as the earlier beta. Physical-device Google sign-in, account deletion, camera, SMS, notification-capture, sharing and reminder tests are still pending. The latest visual browser checks are also pending because the browser permission remains blocked.

Testing feedback

Record the Android version, device model, exact steps, and whether the input was a real or fictional test record. Remove personal payment data from logs and screenshots before sharing it.
